```{r}
  mutate(position = as.numeric(str_extract(mutant, "(?<=\\D)(\\d+)(?=\\D)")))

# Fit a loess model using the filtered data
loess_fit <- loess(DMS_score_activity ~ DMS_score_abundance, data = vkor_df, span = 0.7, family = "symmetric")

# Predict fitted values for ALL data points using the loess model trained on fil_vkor_df
vkor_df$fitted <- predict(loess_fit, newdata = vkor_df)

# Calculate residuals for ALL points

    median_exp_residuals = median(exp_residuals, na.rm = TRUE),
    q1_exp_residuals     = quantile(exp_residuals, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    q3_exp_residuals     = quantile(exp_residuals, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
```

```{r}
# https://www.mdpi.com/2072-6643/7/8/5280
# Four cysteine residues (human VKORC1 sequence numbering: Cys43, Cys51, Cys132, Cys135) are completely conserved among VKORC1 orthologs and are required for in vivo VKOR catalysis
# Additionally, a conserved serine or threonine (human VKORC1 sequence numbering: Ser57) has been shown to be essential for VKOR catalytic activity in vitro

# https://bmcgenomdata.biomedcentral.com/articles/10.1186/1471-2156-15-17?utm_source=chatgpt.com
# proposed TYA binding motif (Thr138-Tyr139-Ala140) which was previously studied by our working group using site-directed mutagenesis 
ortho <- c(
  132, 135,    # catalytic active sites
  43, 51, # electron-transfer loop cysteines
  138:140, # warfarin binding site
  57 # catalytic helper 
)

vkor_ortho <- vkor_df %>% filter(position %in% ortho)
mean(vkor_ortho$exp_residuals) # 

allo <- c(exp_df %>% filter(median_exp_residuals < mean(vkor_ortho$exp_residuals)) %>% filter(!position %in% ortho) %>% pull (position))
allo

full_func <- c(ortho, allo)
```

```{r}
# point this to your actual .cif (or .cif.gz) file
test_cif <- read.cif("/Users/xl7/Downloads/1d5r.cif", rm.alt = TRUE)

standard_aas <- c("ALA","ARG","ASN","ASP","CYS","GLU","GLN","GLY",
                  "HIS","ILE","LEU","LYS","MET","PHE","PRO","SER",
                  "THR","TRP","TYR","VAL")

# Keep all non-hydrogen protein atoms from standard amino acids
# (drop the CA-only filter; also drop hydrogens whose names start with "H")
test_protein_atoms <- test_cif$atom %>%
  filter(resid %in% standard_aas, !grepl("^H", elety)) %>%
  mutate(auth_resid = resno)

test_target_atoms <- test_protein_atoms %>%
  filter(auth_resid %in% ortho)

# Safety check in case target set is empty
if (nrow(test_target_atoms) == 0) {
  stop("No target atoms found for the specified active_site_positions.")
}

# Compute min atom-atom distance from each atom to any target atom
coords <- as.matrix(test_protein_atoms[, c("x","y","z")])
target_coords <- as.matrix(test_target_atoms[, c("x","y","z")])

test_protein_atoms$min_dist_to_targets <- apply(coords, 1, function(p) {
  # p is length-3 numeric vector (x,y,z)
  # compute squared distances to all target atoms, then take sqrt of the minimum
  sqrt(min(colSums((t(target_coords) - p)^2)))
})

# (Optional) Per-residue minimal atom distance to targets
per_residue_min <- test_protein_atoms %>%
  group_by(chain, auth_resid, resid) %>%
  summarise(min_atom_dist = min(min_dist_to_targets), .groups = "drop")

# Results:
# 1) Atom-level: test_protein_atoms
# 2) Residue-level: per_residue_min
test_protein_atoms <- test_protein_atoms %>% group_by(auth_resid) %>% 
  summarise(min_dist_to_targets = min(min_dist_to_targets))
test_protein_atoms
# per_residue_min
```

```{r, fig.height = 4, fig.width = 4}
# ---- Reproducible AUPRC workflow ---------------------------------------------
# Purpose: Compare classifiers (single-score predictors) with PR curves & AUPRC.
# Inputs required in `sub_df`: position, median_exp_residuals, median_esm1v_ddgf_residual, rM
# Optional: vectors `allo`, `allo_second_shell` to define functional sites.

# 0) Setup ----------------------------------------------------------------------
set.seed(42)

theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size = 12))

# 1) Input checks ---------------------------------------------------------------
stopifnot(exists("sub_df"))
needed <- c("position","median_exp_residuals","median_esm1v_ddgf_residual","rM")
if (!all(needed %in% names(sub_df))) {
  stop("`sub_df` must have columns: ", paste(needed, collapse = ", "))
}

# Coerce numeric columns safely (doesn't touch original object)
work_df <- sub_df %>%
  mutate(
    across(c(median_exp_residuals, median_esm1v_ddgf_residual, rM), ~as.numeric(.x)),
    position = as.integer(position)
  )

# 2) Labels ---------------------------------------------------------------------
full_func <- unique(c(allo, ortho))

work_df <- work_df %>%
  mutate(is_full_func = position %in% full_func)

# Validate label has both classes
label_tab <- table(work_df$is_full_func, useNA = "no")
if (length(label_tab) < 2) {
  stop("`is_full_func` must contain both TRUE and FALSE classes for PR analysis.")
}
pos_rate <- mean(work_df$is_full_func)

# 3) Predictor orientation (no destructive sign flips) -------------------------
# If larger scores should indicate the positive (functional) class, flip here explicitly.
# Keep both original and oriented columns for transparency.
work_df <- work_df %>%
  mutate(
    # oriented versions (higher = more likely functional)
    median_exp_residuals_pos         =-median_exp_residuals, 
    rM_pos                       = -rM,                        # since you flipped earlier
    median_esm1v_ddgf_resid_pos  = -median_esm1v_ddgf_residual # since you flipped earlier
  )

# Choose predictors to evaluate (use the oriented ones)
predictors <- c(
  "median_exp_residuals_pos",            # already oriented as "more destabilizing?" -> verify by domain knowledge
  "median_esm1v_ddgf_resid_pos",
  "rM_pos"
)

pretty_names <- c(
  median_exp_residuals_pos           = "median exp residual (flipped)",
  median_esm1v_ddgf_resid_pos = "ESM1v–ddGf residual (flipped)",
  rM_pos                   = "rM (flipped)"
)

# 4) Utilities ------------------------------------------------------------------
pair_complete <- function(scores, y) {
  keep <- !(is.na(scores) | is.na(y))
  list(scores = scores[keep], y = y[keep])
}

safe_pr_auc <- function(scores, y_logical) {
  y_num <- as.integer(y_logical) # 1 for TRUE, 0 for FALSE
  if (sum(y_num == 1) == 0 || sum(y_num == 0) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  pr <- PRROC::pr.curve(
    scores.class0 = scores[y_num == 1],
    scores.class1 = scores[y_num == 0],
    curve = FALSE
  )
  unname(pr$auc.integral)
}

get_pr_curve_df <- function(scores, y_logical, name) {
  y_num <- as.integer(y_logical)
  if (sum(y_num == 1) == 0 || sum(y_num == 0) == 0) {
    return(tibble(recall = numeric(0), precision = numeric(0), threshold = numeric(0),
                  predictor = name, auc = NA_real_))
  }
  pr <- PRROC::pr.curve(
    scores.class0 = scores[y_num == 1],
    scores.class1 = scores[y_num == 0],
    curve = TRUE
  )
  C <- as.matrix(pr$curve)
  tibble(
    recall    = C[,1],
    precision = C[,2],
    threshold = if (ncol(C) >= 3) C[,3] else NA_real_,
    predictor = name,
    auc       = unname(pr$auc.integral)
  )
}

# Optional: bootstrap CI for AUPRC (stratified by class)
bootstrap_auprc <- function(scores, y_logical, B = 500L, seed = 123) {
  set.seed(seed)
  y <- as.integer(y_logical)
  pos_idx <- which(y == 1); neg_idx <- which(y == 0)
  if (length(pos_idx) == 0 || length(neg_idx) == 0) return(c(NA_real_, NA_real_))

  boot_vals <- replicate(B, {
    s_pos <- sample(pos_idx, length(pos_idx), replace = TRUE)
    s_neg <- sample(neg_idx, length(neg_idx), replace = TRUE)
    idx   <- c(s_pos, s_neg)
    safe_pr_auc(scores[idx], y_logical[idx])
  })
  stats::quantile(boot_vals, probs = c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm = TRUE)
}

# 5) Compute AUPRC per predictor -------------------------------------------------
y <- work_df$is_full_func

auprc_tbl <- predictors %>%
  map_dfr(function(p) {
    pair <- pair_complete(work_df[[p]], y)
    auc  <- safe_pr_auc(pair$scores, pair$y)
    ci   <- bootstrap_auprc(pair$scores, pair$y, B = 500L, seed = 999)
    tibble(
      predictor = p,
      predictor_pretty = unname(pretty_names[[p]] %||% p),
      auprc = auc,
      ci_lo = ci[1],
      ci_hi = ci[2],
      n_pos = sum(pair$y),
      n_neg = sum(!pair$y)
    )
  }) %>%
  arrange(desc(auprc))

print(auprc_tbl)

# 1️⃣  Define a fixed order for your predictors (you can change this)
predictor_order <- c(
  "median_exp_residuals_pos",
  "median_esm1v_ddgf_resid_pos",
  "rM_pos"
)

# 2️⃣  Assign matching pretty names and colors
pretty_names <- c(
  median_exp_residuals_pos           = "median exp residual (flipped)",
  median_esm1v_ddgf_resid_pos = "ESM1v–ΔΔGf residual (flipped)",
  rM_pos                   = "rM (flipped)"
)

predictor_colors <- c(
  "median exp residual (flipped)"          = "#E69F00",  # orange
  "ESM1v–ΔΔGf residual (flipped)"  = "#56B4E9",  # blue
  "rM (flipped)"                     = "#009E73"   # green
)
# ---- 7A) Prettier AUPRC bar chart with counts ---------------------------------

# 3️⃣  Add labels, counts, and ordered factors
auprc_tbl <- auprc_tbl %>%
  mutate(
    predictor_pretty = recode(predictor, !!!pretty_names),
    predictor_pretty = factor(predictor_pretty, levels = pretty_names[predictor_order]),
    count_label = sprintf("(%d/%d)", n_pos, n_neg),
    label_text  = sprintf("%.3f %s", auprc, count_label)
  )

# 4️⃣  Build the plot
p_bar <- ggplot(auprc_tbl, aes(x = predictor_pretty, y = auprc, fill = predictor_pretty)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6, color = "grey25") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = ci_lo, ymax = ci_hi), width = 0.15, color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_text(aes(label = label_text), vjust = -2, size = 3.8, fontface = "bold", color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = predictor_colors) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1.05), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "AUPRC",
    fill = "Predictor",
    title = "VKOR (Precision–Recall AUC)",
    subtitle = sprintf("Positive class prevalence = %.3f", pos_rate)
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, angle = 25, hjust = 1, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11)
  ) + ylim(0,1.2)

# 5️⃣  Display it
print(p_bar)
```

```{r, fig.height=3.5, fig.width=6}
# ---- Precision@k% with all sites combined + labels (1,2,5,10,20,30,50%) -------

stopifnot(exists("work_df"), exists("predictors"))

# Reuse previously defined site sets
active_vec <- if (exists("ortho")) ortho else integer()
allo_core  <- if (exists("allo")) allo else integer()
allo_all   <- unique(c(allo_core, if (exists("allo_second_shell")) allo_second_shell else integer()))

# Add combined functional site label
work_all <- work_df %>%
  mutate(
    is_any_func = position %in% unique(c(active_vec, allo_all))
  )

# Compute baseline prevalence
pos_rate_all <- mean(work_all$is_any_func, na.rm = TRUE)

# Precision@k% helper
precision_at_k_percent <- function(scores, y_logical, k_percent) {
  keep <- !(is.na(scores) | is.na(y_logical))
  s <- scores[keep]; y <- y_logical[keep]
  n <- length(s)
  if (n == 0) return(NA_real_)
  k <- ceiling(pmax(1, k_percent/100 * n))
  ord <- order(s, decreasing = TRUE)
  top_k <- y[ord][seq_len(k)]
  sum(top_k, na.rm = TRUE) / k
}

# pretty names fallback
if (!exists("pretty_names")) {
  pretty_names <- setNames(predictors, predictors)
}

# Explicit k-grid
k_grid <- c(1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 30, 50)

# Compute precision@k% table
prec_all_tbl <- purrr::map_dfr(predictors, function(p) {
  s <- work_all[[p]]
  y <- work_all$is_any_func
  purrr::map_dfr(k_grid, function(kp) {
    tibble::tibble(
      predictor        = p,
      predictor_pretty = pretty_names[[p]] %||% p,
      k_percent        = kp,
      k_count          = ceiling(kp/100 * sum(!is.na(s) & !is.na(y))),
      precision_at_k   = precision_at_k_percent(s, y, kp),
      baseline_prev    = pos_rate_all
    )
  })
})

print(prec_all_tbl %>% arrange(k_percent, desc(precision_at_k)))

# color palette fallback
if (!exists("predictor_colors")) {
  predictor_colors <- setNames(scales::hue_pal()(length(unique(prec_all_tbl$predictor_pretty))),
                               unique(prec_all_tbl$predictor_pretty))
}

# Plot: precision vs k% with numeric labels on each dot
p_all <- ggplot(prec_all_tbl,
                aes(x = k_percent, y = precision_at_k,
                    color = predictor_pretty, group = predictor_pretty)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", precision_at_k)),
    vjust = -1, size = 3, fontface = "bold", show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = pos_rate_all, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  scale_color_manual(values = predictor_colors) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = k_grid) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1.05)) +
  labs(
    x = "Top k% (by score)",
    y = "Precision",
    color = "Predictor",
    title = "VKOR: Precision@k%",
    subtitle = sprintf("Dashed line = class prevalence (%.3f)", pos_rate_all)
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 10),
    plot.title   = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    axis.title   = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

print(p_all)
```

```{r, fig.height = 4, fig.width = 12}
all_func <- c(allo, ortho)
## ---- setup -------------------------------------------------------------------
# Reproducibility helpers
set.seed(42)

# Global theme
theme_set(theme_classic(base_size = 12))

## ---- data checks --------------------------------------------------------------
needed_cols <- c("median_exp_residuals", "median_esm1v_ddgf_residual", "rM", "position")
stopifnot(all(needed_cols %in% names(sub_df)))

# Ensure numeric where needed
sub_df <- sub_df %>%
  mutate(
    across(c(median_exp_residuals, median_esm1v_ddgf_residual, rM), as.numeric),
    .keep = "all"
  )

# Define highlighted positions (all_func expected to be a vector)
all_func <- get0("all_func", ifnotfound = character())
if (!is.null(all_func) && !is.vector(all_func)) {
  stop("`all_func` must be a vector of positions to highlight.")
}

## ---- helpers -----------------------------------------------------------------
# Spearman correlation (complete-case, consistent NA handling)
spearman_cor <- function(df, x, y) {
  x <- enquo(x); y <- enquo(y)
  d <- df %>% select(!!x, !!y) %>% tidyr::drop_na()
  if (nrow(d) < 3) return(list(rho = NA_real_, p = NA_real_, n = nrow(d)))
  ct <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(d[[1]], d[[2]], method = "spearman", exact = FALSE))
  list(rho = unname(ct$estimate), p = ct$p.value, n = nrow(d))
}

# Pretty subtitle for plots
subtitle_from_cor <- function(res) {
  if (is.na(res$rho)) return("Spearman ρ: NA (insufficient data)")
  sprintf("Spearman ρ = %.3f (p = %.2e, n = %d)", res$rho, res$p, res$n)
}

# Generic scatter + linear trend + highlight
make_corr_plot <- function(df, x, y, title = "SRC", highlight_positions = NULL) {
  xq <- enquo(x); yq <- enquo(y)

  cor_res <- spearman_cor(df, !!xq, !!yq)
  sub_txt <- subtitle_from_cor(cor_res)

  base <- ggplot(df, aes(x = !!xq, y = !!yq)) +
    geom_point(size = 1, alpha = 0.8, color = "steelblue") +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.7, color = "darkred") +
    labs(title = title, subtitle = sub_txt, x = as_name(xq), y = as_name(yq))

  if (!is.null(highlight_positions) && length(highlight_positions)) {
    base <- base +
      geom_point(
        data = df %>% filter(.data$position %in% highlight_positions),
        size = 1.4,
        color = "orange",
        alpha = 0.95
      )
  }
  base
}

## ---- analyses ----------------------------------------------------------------
# Compute correlations (also printed as a small table)
corr_specs <- list(
  list(x = quo(median_exp_residuals),           y = quo(median_esm1v_ddgf_residual), label = "exp residual vs ESM1v-ddGf residual"),
  list(x = quo(median_exp_residuals),           y = quo(rM),                         label = "exp residual vs rM"),
  list(x = quo(median_esm1v_ddgf_residual), y = quo(rM),                       label = "ESM1v-ddGf residual vs rM")
)

corr_table <- purrr::map_dfr(corr_specs, function(sp) {
  res <- spearman_cor(sub_df, !!sp$x, !!sp$y)
  tibble::tibble(
    comparison = sp$label,
    rho = res$rho,
    p_value = res$p,
    n = res$n
  )
})

print(corr_table)

## ---- figures -----------------------------------------------------------------
p_corr_residual <- make_corr_plot(
  sub_df,
  median_exp_residuals,
  median_esm1v_ddgf_residual,
  title = "VKOR",
  highlight_positions = all_func
) + labs(x = "experimental residual", y = "ESM1v - ddGf residual")

p_corr_rM <- make_corr_plot(
  sub_df,
  median_exp_residuals,
  rM,
  title = "VKOR",
  highlight_positions = all_func
) + labs(x = "experimental residual", y = "rM")

p_corr <- make_corr_plot(
  sub_df,
  median_esm1v_ddgf_residual,
  rM,
  title = "VKOR",
  highlight_positions = all_func
) + labs(x = "ESM1v - ddGf residual", y = "rM")

cowplot::plot_grid(p_corr_residual, p_corr_rM, p_corr, ncol = 3)
```
